notes: Removes brittle parsing of the literal TAP summary line # pass 11 from the 17.0.71 nested cross-version server regression.
Preserves the existing child-process exit-status assertion and Firebase target mismatch guard, so emulator/live validation remains fail-closed.
Adds targeted Node, mandatory Play Store/release-gate Playwright, and independent Playwright regression coverage that exercises a non-TAP Node reporter.
title: 86 Chaos 17.0.72
summary: Repairs the 17.0.71 server regression so Yardmaster full-gate validation does not depend on a specific Node test reporter summary format.
description: Surgical test-harness repair. Nested cross-version server validation now trusts the child process exit status, which is reporter-independent, while preserving the existing LIVE/EMULATOR Firebase target checks and production runtime behavior.
highlights: Nested Node regression success is determined by process exit status instead of reporter text.
A new regression runs the wrapper with NODE_OPTIONS=--test-reporter=spec to reproduce the reporter-variation failure path.
No application runtime, Firebase target selection, security policy, or production deployment behavior is changed.
